sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Knowledge examination

FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A01
The vision standard is twenty-forty with both eyes, yet an applicant with a single eye passes with twenty-forty in that eye, and neither may be reached with bi-optic or telescopic lenses [A01].
Why it matters: group vision; difficulty medium; prereq sec06-F04; confusables sec06-F04, sec06-F05, sec06-F06 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A01
The knowledge examination asks at least twenty-five questions and requires nineteen correct answers, and an unanswered question counts as wrong once the time limit runs out [A01].
Why it matters: group knowledge-test; difficulty medium; prereq sec06-F09; confusables sec06-F09, sec06-F10 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A01
The audio knowledge test covers the same material under the same rules as the printed test, so staff may not read, reword or explain questions for either version [A01].
Why it matters: group knowledge-test; difficulty low; prereq sec06-F11; confusables sec06-F10, sec06-F11 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A02
A minor defect may be corrected so the road test continues, but switching to a different vehicle on the same test date is not permitted [A02].
Why it matters: group road-test-vehicle; difficulty medium; prereq sec06-F14; confusables sec06-F13, sec06-F14 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A02
A vehicle may carry at most one spotlight, two side cowl or fender lights and two backup lights, and backup lights must never show light while moving forward [A02].
Why it matters: group illegal-equipment; difficulty high; prereq sec06-F16; confusables sec06-F16, sec06-F17 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: A02
A load may not extend beyond the fender line at all on the left side but may extend up to six inches beyond it on the right side [A02].
Why it matters: group illegal-equipment; difficulty high; prereq sec06-F17; confusables sec06-F17 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: A02
Window tint must let through at least thirty-five percent of light, and a cracked windshield or a broken lens is illegal equipment regardless of tint [A02].
Why it matters: group illegal-equipment; difficulty medium; prereq sec06-F18; confusables sec06-F18 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: A01
Needing glasses to reach twenty-forty earns a corrective lenses restriction, whereas vision that cannot be corrected to twenty-forty requires a vision specialist's statement and possible advisory board review [A01].
Why it matters: group vision; difficulty medium; prereq sec06-F06; confusables sec06-F06, sec06-F07, sec06-F08 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec06-R09 | anchor: A02
The short DUI awareness course after the road skills test is required of first-time applicants and of out-of-state drivers coming into West Virginia even if they once held a West Virginia license [A02].
Why it matters: group dui-awareness; difficulty low; prereq sec06-F12; confusables sec06-F12 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]
